body:
## Reproduction

The current `.github/workflows/desktop-release.yml` invokes `actions/download-artifact@v8` twice in the `finalize` job without a targeted Node warning policy. On current GitHub-hosted runners each invocation can emit:

```text
[DEP0005] DeprecationWarning: Buffer() is deprecated due to security and usability issues.
```

The warning comes from the action bundled dependency, not from repository code. The upstream action report is actions/download-artifact#484. The same warning was observed once per v8 invocation in link-assistant/formal-ai run 31871548794 while auditing link-assistant/formal-ai#1012.

## Workaround

Add this environment only to each `actions/download-artifact@v8` step:

```yaml
env:
  NODE_OPTIONS: --disable-warning=DEP0005
```

This preserves every other Node warning and suppresses only the reviewed transitive diagnostic. Avoid a workflow-wide `NODE_OPTIONS` or `--no-warnings`, since either could hide unrelated warnings.

## Suggested code fix

Apply the targeted environment to both download steps in the desktop `finalize` job and add a workflow regression test which checks every v8 download step for `--disable-warning=DEP0005`. Remove the workaround after actions/download-artifact#484 is fixed and the pinned major contains the fix.
title: Suppress actions/download-artifact v8 DEP0005 warnings
